def render_g_indicadores_por_campus(pdf, dataframes, x, y, w, h):
    # Get the primary dataframe
    df = list(dataframes.values())[0]
    if df is None or df.empty:
        # Placeholder: draw a simple text box indicating no data
        pdf.set_xy(x, y)
        pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "I", 8)
        pdf.multi_cell(w, 5, "Dados insuficientes para gerar o gráfico.", align='C')
        return

    # Aggregate by campus (mean of each metric)
    grouped = df.groupby('campus', as_index=False).agg({
        'completion_rate': 'mean',
        'placement_rate': 'mean',
        'satisfaction': 'mean'
    })

    campus_names = grouped['campus'].tolist()
    completion_means = grouped['completion_rate'].values
    placement_means = grouped['placement_rate'].values
    satisfaction_means = grouped['satisfaction'].values

    # Create figure with constrained layout for better margin control
    fig, ax1 = plt.subplots(figsize=(w/25.4, h/25.4), constrained_layout=True)

    # Positions for bars (3 groups, 3 bars per group)
    n_groups = len(campus_names)
    bar_width = 0.25
    positions = np.arange(n_groups)
    pos1 = positions - bar_width
    pos2 = positions
    pos3 = positions + bar_width

    # Left y-axis: completion and placement (rates)
    bars1 = ax1.bar(pos1, completion_means, bar_width, label='Conclusão', color='#4C72B0', edgecolor='white')
    bars2 = ax1.bar(pos2, placement_means, bar_width, label='Colocação', color='#55A868', edgecolor='white')

    # Right y-axis: satisfaction (scale 0-10)
    ax2 = ax1.twinx()
    bars3 = ax2.bar(pos3, satisfaction_means, bar_width, label='Satisfação', color='#C44E52', edgecolor='white')

    # Set axis labels
    ax1.set_ylabel('Taxa', fontsize=CHART_LABEL_FONTSIZE)
    ax2.set_ylabel('Satisfação (0–10)', fontsize=CHART_LABEL_FONTSIZE)

    # Set x-axis ticks and labels
    ax1.set_xticks(positions)
    ax1.set_xticklabels(campus_names, fontsize=CHART_TICK_FONTSIZE)

    # Adjust y-limits (left: 0 to 1 with some headroom, right: 0 to 10)
    ax1.set_ylim(0, 1.0)
    ax2.set_ylim(0, 10)

    # Title using shared constants
    ax1.set_title('Indicadores de Resultado por Campus', fontsize=CHART_TITLE_FONTSIZE,
                  fontweight=CHART_TITLE_FONTWEIGHT, pad=CHART_TITLE_PAD)

    # Legend: place at bottom, outside the axes (3 columns)
    lines1, labels1 = ax1.get_legend_handles_labels()
    lines2, labels2 = ax2.get_legend_handles_labels()
    ax1.legend(lines1 + lines2, labels1 + labels2,
               loc='upper center', bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.25), ncol=3,
               frameon=False, fontsize=CHART_LEGEND_FONTSIZE)

    # Reserve margin at bottom for legend
    # (constrained_layout is already active, but we add extra bottom margin if needed)
    fig.subplots_adjust(bottom=0.28)

    # Save and insert into PDF
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".png", delete=False) as tmp:
        plt.savefig(tmp.name, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.05)
        plt.close()
        pdf.image(tmp.name, x=x, y=y, w=w, h=h)
        os.unlink(tmp.name)

def render_g_taxas_por_programa(pdf, dataframes, x, y, w, h):
    # --- data extraction ---
    df = dataframes.get('student_outcomes.xlsx')
    if df is None or df.empty:
        # fallback to first available dataframe (should not happen normally)
        df = list(dataframes.values())[0]
    if df is None or df.empty:
        return

    # aggregate completion and placement rates per program
    agg = df.groupby('program', as_index=False)[['completion_rate', 'placement_rate']].mean()
    programs = agg['program'].tolist()
    comp_rates = agg['completion_rate'].tolist()
    place_rates = agg['placement_rate'].tolist()

    # --- plot setup (compact block) ---
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(w / 25.4, h / 25.4))
    fig.subplots_adjust(top=0.80, bottom=0.30, left=0.12, right=0.95)

    # bar parameters
    x_vals = np.arange(len(programs))
    bar_width = 0.35
    offset = bar_width / 2

    # colors
    color_comp = sns.color_palette("Set2")[0]   # e.g. green
    color_place = sns.color_palette("Set2")[1]  # e.g. orange

    # bars
    ax.bar(x_vals - offset, comp_rates, bar_width,
           label='Conclusão', color=color_comp, edgecolor='white')
    ax.bar(x_vals + offset, place_rates, bar_width,
           label='Colocação', color=color_place, edgecolor='white')

    # --- styling ---
    ax.set_title('Taxas por Programa',
                 fontsize=CHART_TITLE_FONTSIZE,
                 fontweight=CHART_TITLE_FONTWEIGHT,
                 pad=CHART_TITLE_PAD)

    # x axis (no label)
    ax.set_xticks(x_vals)
    ax.set_xticklabels(programs, fontsize=CHART_TICK_FONTSIZE)
    ax.tick_params(axis='x', pad=4)

    # y axis
    ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
    ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(plt.FuncFormatter(lambda v, _: f'{v:.0%}'))
    ax.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=CHART_TICK_FONTSIZE)

    # legend below (no x‑axis label, so this is safe)
    ax.legend(loc='upper center', bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.30),
              ncol=3, frameon=False, fontsize=CHART_LEGEND_FONTSIZE)

    # clean up spines
    sns.despine(ax=ax)

    # --- save and insert into PDF ---
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".png", delete=False) as tmp:
        plt.savefig(tmp.name, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.05)
        plt.close()
        pdf.image(tmp.name, x=x, y=y, w=w, h=h)
        os.unlink(tmp.name)

def render_g_orcamento_por_campus(pdf, dataframes, x, y, w, h):
    # Access the budget dataframe
    df = dataframes.get('campus_budget.csv')
    if df is None or df.empty:
        return

    # Prepare data: melt to long format for grouped bars
    df_melt = df.melt(id_vars='campus', var_name='Budget Type', value_name='Budget')
    df_melt['Budget (k)'] = df_melt['Budget'] / 1000.0  # convert to thousands

    # Create figure with exact dimensions
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(w / 25.4, h / 25.4))

    # Plot grouped bar chart
    sns.barplot(
        data=df_melt, x='campus', y='Budget (k)', hue='Budget Type',
        ax=ax, palette='viridis', edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5
    )

    # Chart title
    ax.set_title(
        'Distribuição do Orçamento por Campus',
        fontsize=CHART_TITLE_FONTSIZE,
        fontweight=CHART_TITLE_FONTWEIGHT,
        pad=CHART_TITLE_PAD
    )

    # Axis labels
    ax.set_xlabel('')   # omit x-axis label – tick labels suffice
    ax.set_ylabel('Orçamento (k)', fontsize=CHART_LABEL_FONTSIZE)

    # Tick parameters
    ax.tick_params(axis='both', labelsize=CHART_TICK_FONTSIZE)
    ax.set_xticklabels(ax.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)

    # Legend – place inside plot (upper right) to avoid bottom + xlabel conflict
    legend = ax.legend(
        loc='upper right',
        fontsize=CHART_LEGEND_FONTSIZE,
        frameon=True, framealpha=0.9
    )

    # Adjust layout for small height
    fig.subplots_adjust(top=0.80, bottom=0.15, left=0.12, right=0.92)

    # Save to temporary file and paste into PDF

        plt.savefig(tmp.name, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.05)

def render_g_custo_vs_colocacao(pdf, dataframes, x, y, w, h):
    outcomes = dataframes.get('student_outcomes.xlsx')
    budget = dataframes.get('campus_budget.csv')
    if outcomes is None or budget is None or outcomes.empty or budget.empty:
        return

    # Aggregate per campus
    campus_agg = outcomes.groupby('campus', as_index=False).agg(
        total_students=('students', 'sum'),
        avg_placement=('placement_rate', 'mean')
    )

    merged = pd.merge(campus_agg, budget, on='campus', how='inner')
    if merged.empty:
        return

    merged['cost_per_student'] = merged['instruction_budget'] / merged['total_students']

    campuses = merged['campus'].tolist()
    x_vals = merged['cost_per_student'].values
    y_vals = merged['avg_placement'].values

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(w / 25.4, h / 25.4), constrained_layout=True)

    colors = ['#1f77b4', '#ff7f0e', '#2ca02c']
    for i, campus in enumerate(campuses):
        ax.scatter(x_vals[i], y_vals[i], c=colors[i], s=80, label=campus, zorder=3)

    ax.set_xlabel('Custo por Aluno (R$)', fontsize=CHART_LABEL_FONTSIZE)
    ax.set_ylabel('Taxa de Colocação', fontsize=CHART_LABEL_FONTSIZE)
    ax.set_title('Custo por Aluno vs Taxa de Colocação',
                 fontsize=CHART_TITLE_FONTSIZE,
                 fontweight=CHART_TITLE_FONTWEIGHT,
                 pad=CHART_TITLE_PAD)

    ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(plt.FuncFormatter(lambda v, _: f'{v:.0%}'))
    ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(plt.FuncFormatter(lambda v, _: f'R${v / 1000:.0f}K'))

    ax.tick_params(axis='both', labelsize=CHART_TICK_FONTSIZE)
    ax.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=CHART_LEGEND_FONTSIZE, frameon=False)

    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix='.png', delete=False) as tmp:
        plt.savefig(tmp.name, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.05)
        plt.close()
        pdf.image(tmp.name, x=x, y=y, w=w, h=h)
        os.unlink(tmp.name)

import os
os.environ.setdefault('MPLCONFIGDIR', '/tmp/matplotlib')
import json
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib as mpl
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from fpdf import FPDF, XPos, YPos
import tempfile
import textwrap

CHART_TITLE_FONTSIZE = 9
CHART_TITLE_FONTWEIGHT = 'bold'
CHART_TITLE_PAD = 6
CHART_LABEL_FONTSIZE = 7
CHART_TICK_FONTSIZE = 6
CHART_LEGEND_FONTSIZE = 6
CHART_TABLE_FONTSIZE = 6
sns.set_theme(style='whitegrid')
mpl.rcParams.update({
    'axes.titlesize': CHART_TITLE_FONTSIZE,
    'axes.titleweight': CHART_TITLE_FONTWEIGHT,
    'axes.labelsize': CHART_LABEL_FONTSIZE,
    'xtick.labelsize': CHART_TICK_FONTSIZE,
    'ytick.labelsize': CHART_TICK_FONTSIZE,
    'legend.fontsize': CHART_LEGEND_FONTSIZE,
})

def _install_standard_chart_style():
    from matplotlib.axes import Axes
    original_set_title = Axes.set_title
    original_set_xlabel = Axes.set_xlabel
    original_set_ylabel = Axes.set_ylabel
    original_tick_params = Axes.tick_params
    original_legend = Axes.legend
    original_plt_legend = plt.legend
    def set_title(self, label, fontdict=None, loc=None, pad=None, *, y=None, **kwargs):
        fontdict = dict(fontdict or {})
        fontdict['fontsize'] = CHART_TITLE_FONTSIZE
        fontdict['fontweight'] = CHART_TITLE_FONTWEIGHT
        kwargs['fontsize'] = CHART_TITLE_FONTSIZE
        kwargs['fontweight'] = CHART_TITLE_FONTWEIGHT
        return original_set_title(self, label, fontdict=fontdict, loc=loc, pad=CHART_TITLE_PAD if pad is None else pad, y=y, **kwargs)
    def set_xlabel(self, xlabel, fontdict=None, labelpad=None, loc=None, **kwargs):
        fontdict = dict(fontdict or {})
        fontdict['fontsize'] = CHART_LABEL_FONTSIZE
        fontdict['fontweight'] = 'normal'
        kwargs['fontsize'] = CHART_LABEL_FONTSIZE
        kwargs['fontweight'] = 'normal'
        return original_set_xlabel(self, xlabel, fontdict=fontdict, labelpad=labelpad, loc=loc, **kwargs)
    def set_ylabel(self, ylabel, fontdict=None, labelpad=None, loc=None, **kwargs):
        fontdict = dict(fontdict or {})
        fontdict['fontsize'] = CHART_LABEL_FONTSIZE
        fontdict['fontweight'] = 'normal'
        kwargs['fontsize'] = CHART_LABEL_FONTSIZE
        kwargs['fontweight'] = 'normal'
        return original_set_ylabel(self, ylabel, fontdict=fontdict, labelpad=labelpad, loc=loc, **kwargs)
    def tick_params(self, axis='both', **kwargs):
        kwargs['labelsize'] = CHART_TICK_FONTSIZE
        return original_tick_params(self, axis=axis, **kwargs)
    def legend(self, *args, **kwargs):
        kwargs['fontsize'] = CHART_LEGEND_FONTSIZE
        return original_legend(self, *args, **kwargs)
    def plt_legend(*args, **kwargs):
        kwargs['fontsize'] = CHART_LEGEND_FONTSIZE
        return original_plt_legend(*args, **kwargs)
    Axes.set_title = set_title
    Axes.set_xlabel = set_xlabel
    Axes.set_ylabel = set_ylabel
    Axes.tick_params = tick_params
    Axes.legend = legend
    plt.legend = plt_legend

_install_standard_chart_style()

def _safe_pdf_text(value):
    replacements = {
        '\u2013': '-', '\u2014': '-', '\u2015': '-',
        '\u2018': "'", '\u2019': "'", '\u201c': '"', '\u201d': '"',
        '\u2022': '-', '\u00a0': ' ', '\u2026': '...'
    }
    text = str(value or '')
    for source, target in replacements.items():
        text = text.replace(source, target)
    return text.encode('latin-1', 'replace').decode('latin-1')

def _wrap_lines(text, max_chars):
    lines = []
    for paragraph in str(text).splitlines() or ['']:
        wrapped = textwrap.wrap(paragraph.strip(), width=max_chars) or ['']
        lines.extend(wrapped)
    return lines

def _sentence_chunks(text):
    normalized = ' '.join(str(text).split())
    chunks, current = [], []
    for token in normalized.split(' '):
        current.append(token)
        if token.rstrip().endswith(('.', '!', '?', ';')):
            chunks.append(' '.join(current))
            current = []
    if current:
        chunks.append(' '.join(current))
    return chunks or [normalized]

def _fit_text_to_box(text, w, h, font_size, line_height):
    max_chars = max(14, int(w * 0.55 * (10 / max(font_size, 1))))
    max_lines = max(1, int(h / max(line_height, 1)))
    if len(_wrap_lines(text, max_chars)) <= max_lines:
        return text
    selected = []
    for sentence in _sentence_chunks(text):
        candidate = ' '.join(selected + [sentence]).strip()
        if not candidate:
            continue
        if len(_wrap_lines(candidate, max_chars)) <= max_lines:
            selected.append(sentence)
        elif selected:
            break
        else:
            words = sentence.split()
            compact = []
            for word in words:
                candidate = ' '.join(compact + [word])
                if len(_wrap_lines(candidate, max_chars)) > max_lines:
                    break
                compact.append(word)
            selected.append(' '.join(compact))
            break
    fitted = ' '.join(selected).strip()
    return fitted

def _write_report_title(pdf, title, font_family):
    clean_title = ' '.join(_safe_pdf_text(title or 'Relatório Analítico').split())
    for size in range(16, 10, -1):
        max_chars = max(28, int(58 * (16 / size)))
        lines = textwrap.wrap(clean_title, width=max_chars) or [clean_title]
        if len(lines) <= 2:
            pdf.set_font(font_family, 'B', size)
            pdf.multi_cell(0, 8, '\n'.join(lines), new_x=XPos.LMARGIN, new_y=YPos.NEXT, align='C')
            return
    pdf.set_font(font_family, 'B', 11)
    pdf.multi_cell(0, 7, '\n'.join(textwrap.wrap(clean_title, width=84)), new_x=XPos.LMARGIN, new_y=YPos.NEXT, align='C')

def render_text_block(pdf, text, x, y, w, h, title=None):
    font_size = 10
    line_height = 5
    text = _safe_pdf_text(text)
    title = _safe_pdf_text(title) if title else None
    body_height = h
    pdf.set_xy(x, y)
    if title:
        pdf.set_font('helvetica', 'B', font_size)
        pdf.cell(w, 7, title, new_x=XPos.LMARGIN, new_y=YPos.NEXT)
        body_height = max(1, h - 8)
        pdf.set_xy(x, pdf.get_y())
    
    fitted_text = _fit_text_to_box(text, w, body_height, font_size, line_height)
    pdf.set_font('helvetica', '', font_size)
    pdf.multi_cell(w, line_height, fitted_text, align='J')

def render_g_custo_vs_colocacao(pdf, dataframes, x, y, w, h):
    outcomes = dataframes.get('student_outcomes.xlsx')
    budget = dataframes.get('campus_budget.csv')
    if outcomes is None or budget is None or outcomes.empty or budget.empty:
        return

    # Aggregate per campus
    campus_agg = outcomes.groupby('campus', as_index=False).agg(
        total_students=('students', 'sum'),
        avg_placement=('placement_rate', 'mean')
    )

    merged = pd.merge(campus_agg, budget, on='campus', how='inner')
    if merged.empty:
        return

    merged['cost_per_student'] = merged['instruction_budget'] / merged['total_students']

    campuses = merged['campus'].tolist()
    x_vals = merged['cost_per_student'].values
    y_vals = merged['avg_placement'].values

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(w / 25.4, h / 25.4), constrained_layout=True)

    colors = ['#1f77b4', '#ff7f0e', '#2ca02c']
    for i, campus in enumerate(campuses):
        ax.scatter(x_vals[i], y_vals[i], c=colors[i], s=80, label=campus, zorder=3)

    ax.set_xlabel('Custo por Aluno (R$)', fontsize=CHART_LABEL_FONTSIZE)
    ax.set_ylabel('Taxa de Colocação', fontsize=CHART_LABEL_FONTSIZE)
    ax.set_title('Custo por Aluno vs Taxa de Colocação',
                 fontsize=CHART_TITLE_FONTSIZE,
                 fontweight=CHART_TITLE_FONTWEIGHT,
                 pad=CHART_TITLE_PAD)

    ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(plt.FuncFormatter(lambda v, _: f'{v:.0%}'))
    ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(plt.FuncFormatter(lambda v, _: f'R${v / 1000:.0f}K'))

    ax.tick_params(axis='both', labelsize=CHART_TICK_FONTSIZE)
    ax.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=CHART_LEGEND_FONTSIZE, frameon=False)

    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix='.png', delete=False) as tmp:
        plt.savefig(tmp.name, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.05)
        plt.close()
        pdf.image(tmp.name, x=x, y=y, w=w, h=h)
        os.unlink(tmp.name)
